name: GMAT Script
comment: Portable TextMate highlighting for GMAT mission scripts. Mirrors the tree-sitter highlights.scm token taxonomy (docs/design/decisions.md, D3) so highlighting works without the language server. Semantic refinement (the LSP) is supplementary.

comments.comment: Line comment: % to end of line.
comments.name: comment.line.percentage.gmat

strings.comment: Single-quoted string / command label. The grammar forbids embedded newlines and quotes.
strings.name: string.quoted.single.gmat

create.comment: `Create <Type> <name>` — colour the resource type distinctly from the Create keyword.

patterns.comment: Structural keywords: configuration/sequence boundaries, control flow, solver blocks, the function header. Resource types and command heads are generic (D3) and intentionally not keywords.
patterns.name: keyword.control.gmat

member.comment: A dotted field / property access — the trailing name of `Sat.SMA`, `FM.GravityField.Earth`.
